record.title: Turkmenistan bars foreign trucks/drivers while allowing cargo transfer
record.scope: Foreign road-carrier entry; later Uzbekistan–Iran transit corridor
record.exceptions: Transloading at Farap/Garabogaz; rail cargo; later non-contact truck handovers
record.enforcement: CAREC records operational prohibition; Turkmen customs confirms selected corridor resumption.
record.context: Goods could move using Turkmen carriers; foreign carriers could not routinely transit.

No independent traffic observation retrieved. Cargo transfer had remained possible during the foreign-truck prohibition.

Cargo transfer and rail access do not constitute restoration of foreign-carrier through-road operation.

Prior check: applicable unchanged claim
